profile.headline: Staff Software Engineer at Stripe
profile.summary: Proven technical leader with large scale distributed systems and networking experience

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Filesystem API Tech Lead at Dropbox

positions.title: Graduate Research Assistant
positions.description: Software development, independent problem solving, data analysis and exploration. I am a PhD student working with Nick Feamster on Internet censorship. I build measurement tools to collect and analyze data at the scale of the Internet.

positions.title: Graduate Research Assistant
positions.description: Software development, independently solving and adapting to problems. I was a PhD student with Nick Feamster at Georgia Tech and I built network measurement systems to detect Internet censorship.

positions.title: Head Teaching Assistant for OMS CS 6250
positions.description:
-Head Teaching Assistant for Georgia Tech's Online Masters Course CS 6250 (Computer Networks)
-Instructed students through a short review of content in online office hours
-Developed two assignments and students were able to pick up the material

positions.title: Summer Research Intern
positions.description: Analyzed network measurements for manipulation of the DNS root across the globe with Vern Paxson and Nick Weaver.

positions.title: Software Development Intern
positions.description: Developed code for the company′s iPhone application. I also independently wrote the code for a substantial component and was awarded Sprint Hero by my development team.

honors.title: OTF Senior Fellow in Information Controls
honors.description: I was awarded a fellowship from the Open Tech Fund to work on Internet censorship measurement for the 2015-2016 academic year. The fellowship provides support for the 2015-2016 academic year as well as a travel stipend for conference travel.
honors.issuer: Issued by Open Tech Fund (OTF) · Jul 2015

honors.title: NSF GRFP Honorable Mention
honors.description: Out of thousands of applicants, I was one of 3 honorable mentions (1 winner) in the area of Computer Security for the NSF Graduate Research Fellowship Program (GRFP).
honors.issuer: Issued by National Science Foundation (NSF) · May 2015

publications.title: Detecting DNS Root Manipulation
publications.publisher: Passive and Active Measurements Conference · Apr 1, 2016
